Through my previous experience in IT organization, data management, and process automation, I have developed a strong understanding of both technical and business perspectives. This enables me to quickly grasp complex structures and implement solutions in an efficient and goal-oriented manner.

Alongside my studies, I work on smaller automation and integration projects, utilizing modern tools such as Make, Power Automate, and Microsoft 365 to streamline business processes and support digital initiatives.

My goal is to create sustainable value in digital projects through analytical thinking, technical expertise, and a hands-on approach, while continuously developing both professionally and personally.

data.summary: In most companies, well-paid people spend a large part of their day on busywork: transferring receipts. Sorting requests. Tracking deadlines. Writing standard replies. Reconciling confirmations. It's not their actual work. It's the work that surrounds their actual work. And it's not a competence problem — it's a coordination problem. I founded Soforce because in 20+ years across software engineering and management consulting, I kept seeing the same thing: the biggest efficiency gains don't come from new tools, but from automating the connections between the tools you already have. Soforce takes over that busywork — end-to-end. We don't build software someone has to learn. We build processes that run in the background, in the systems you already use, with us taking responsibility for the outcome: monitored, escalated when a human is genuinely needed, and honest about what worked and what didn't. Today, Soforce runs automations for firms whose days are full of exactly this work — client documents, requests, deadlines, correspondence. I enjoy talking to firm owners, advisors, and founders who feel their team could achieve more — if only less stood in the way. → www.soforce.ai

data.summary: I did a business degree. Then I taught myself to ship Rust.Most engineers I know can't read a P&L. Most business people I know can't debug a Kubernetes cluster at 2am. I do both, and it turns out that's the whole job.I started my first company at 19, before university. €125,000 net revenue in year one, and €15 back for every €1 clients put into ads. That taught me what a business actually pays for, and it isn't features. It's outcomes.Then I went the other direction. B.Sc. at Frankfurt School of Finance & Management, then years spent learning to build the systems myself: backend, data infrastructure, mobile, and the deployment underneath all of it. Mostly Rust, Python and TypeScript, on Postgres, with Kubernetes below.Today I work as a software engineer on regulated software, the kind where a legal or financial process has to become something people are willing to trust with their company.The point isn't that I can do two jobs. It's that there's no translation layer between the business case and the schema. I've sat in both rooms, so I know which requirements are real and which ones someone made up in a meeting.I keep a few things of my own running outside work as well. That's where I own every architectural decision end to end and then live with it.How I work:→ Domain-driven design→ Test first→ Evidence before claimsI work with AI agents constantly. The hard part was never generating code. It was proving the code does what I say it does. So I built my own verification workflow to make agent output auditable, and I hold my own work to it before anyone else's.I've founded before and I intend to found again. Right now I'm compounding the engineering depth to do it properly.Why I work like this: at 17, my father had a brain hemorrhage and I became the one who had to figure things out. That instinct never left. Find the broken thing, own it, fix it properly.German-Vietnamese, based near Stuttgart. I write about the work at jacksonly.xyz.Let's talk if you're wrestling with:• Domain-driven design in practice• Building software with AI agents you can actually trust• Getting a product from zero to paying customersMessage me.

During my studies and professional experiences, I developed skills in market analysis, business modeling, strategic decision-making, and brand development, while gaining practical experience across client engagement, business operations, and brand presentation.Studying and living in New York City shaped my perspective as a strategic designer and strengthened my ambition to build at the intersection of creativity and business. At WHU, I am now expanding this foundation through entrepreneurship, with a particular interest in turning ideas into meaningful and scalable ventures.

position.title: Gründer:in
position.description:
Wochenenden, die mit Schichtplanung gefüllt waren statt mit Erholung. Urlaubswünsche, die irgendwo untergingen. Überstunden, die niemand im Blick hatte. Ein Monat Planung kostete mich Tage, nicht Stunden.
Irgendwann wollte ich nur noch eines: dass dieser ganze Aufwand einfach verschwindet. Genau aus diesem Gefühl heraus ist PEPP entstanden.
PEPP schreibt den monatlichen Dienstplan für kleine Teams im Einzelhandel automatisch. In vier Durchläufen entsteht ein kompletter Monat: Regel-Schichten zuerst, dann Joker-Tage für Flexibilität, danach die Notfall-Reserve. Was sonst Stunden oder Tage kostet, passiert mit einem Klick. Und PEPP behält dabei alles im Blick, was man sonst im Kopf behalten musste: Minijob-Grenzen, Überstunden-Konten, Urlaubssperren und eine faire Verteilung der unbeliebten Zeiten. Alles rechtskonform. Das Team sieht seine Dienste danach direkt auf dem Handy, die Geschäftsführung stimmt nur noch zu.
Ehrlich: PEPP ist in Gründung. Jung, ehrgeizig und genau deshalb auf der Suche nach Pilot-Teams, die PEPP im echten Ladenalltag mitgestalten. Was Dich an Deiner Dienstplanung nervt, formt PEPP.

data.summary: I don't think of myself as someone who designs interfaces. I think of myself as someone who solves problems.My career started in product design, but over time I realized the best solutions don't come from design alone. They come from understanding people, learning the technology, and building ideas quickly enough to test whether they actually work.That mindset has taken me from designing digital products for eCommerce and retail to leading a cross-functional team on a live AI product, and building AI-powered experiences for healthcare. Today, I'm working with researchers and engineers on RAG systems and AI interfaces designed for highly regulated environments where accuracy, trust, and human-centered design aren't features, they're the whole job.My strength is speed and curiosity: I understand what people actually need fast, and my design and tech background lets me prototype the answer just as fast  before it becomes an expensive assumption.I like working where design, technology, and business overlap, and I'm always pushing new AI tools to their limits to see where they break and what they make newly possible.If you're building AI-first products and need someone who can connect users, technology, and execution, I'd love to connect. I'm especially interested in Product Design Engineer, AI Product, and Project Management opportunities.

data.summary: Put 1,000 ambitious people in a roomand you still don’t get a great startup ecosystem. Because talent is not the bottleneck. Direction is. - People build the wrong things.- Talk to the wrong people.- Learn the same lessons twice. That’s the problem I work on. I’m Director of the Entrepreneurship Center at WHU.But what I actually do is build the operating layer of a startup community. - I connect people earlier.- I make patterns visible.- I turn stories into infrastructure. Because the best communities scale through: - shared memory - fast connections - and environments where ambition compounds  At WHU, I operate inside one of those environments:15 unicorns, a disproportionate share of venture capital, and a network where people actually reply. What drives this is something I think about a lot: Ambition density. Put enough ambitious people in one place,and the baseline shifts. An environment where doing something ambitious feels normal…and doing nothing starts to feel like a choice. I write about: - how founders actually find leverage - why business talent is underrated - how ecosystems shape outcomes - and why most advantages are structural, not individual  Because the real edge is rarely the idea.It’s understanding the game…and finding the right people to play it with.
data.headline: I help business talent become useful in startups. I run WHU’s Entrepreneurship Center, connect founders with the right WHU alums, and write about ambition density and startup communities

multiLocaleCompanyName.de_DE: WHU – Otto Beisheim School of Management

position.description:
WHU - Otto Beisheim School of Management is the #1 German Business School for degree programs. It is the birthplace of 15 unicorn startups (more than any other university in the DACH region), and Germany's #1 university in "number of top-500 startups per student".

The WHU Entrepreneurship Center coordinates the WHU entrepreneurship community. (1) We encourage WHU members to become entrepreneurs by mapping and activating the WHU entrepreneurship community and celebrating its successes. (2) We help them exploit the best opportunities by actively encouraging technology universities, VCs, and corporations to come to us for business-minded co-founders for their own spin-offs and talent pools. (3) And we fast-track their entrepreneurial journey by connecting aspiring WHU entrepreneurs with world-class mentors and investors from WHU’s exclusive alumni network.

position.title: Head of Coaching
position.description:
Main Responsibilities: Research, coaching, presentations, networking 

Member of the Innovation and Entrepreneurship (WIN) chair and the Entrepreneurship Center of RWTH Aachen (Germany's largest technical university). I headed the coaching of all students and researchers that were in the process of founding their own startup companies. Our coaching was conducted by a high profile team with backgrounds in strategy consulting, blue chips, and startups that performed events, workshops, and 1-on-1 coaching. Starting in 2019, RWTH received 8-digit funding to advance its entrepreneurship support which gives us the opportunity to bring our coaching to the next level.

position.title: Co-founder & Head of Sales
position.description:
Main Responsibilities: Hiring, fundraising, partner & customer acquisition, online marketing, strategy

Goodnity motivated young audiences to participate in market research and philanthropy by providing charitable donations for answering mobile surveys. My main responsibility was the acquisition of partners. We secured 6-digit funding from the EU, the German Federal Ministry for Economic Affairs and Energy, and business angels. We received positive coverage from famous German media outlets, built an outstandingly active user base, and entered negotiations with leading market research organizations. The cycle-length and project-character of our sales efforts and therefore missing scalability led us to re-evaluate Goodnity’s business model and form a new company, WorkSpex.

position.title: Chairman, General Management
position.description:
Main Responsibilities: Fundraising, networking, event coordination, mentoring

3DS is an international startup incubation event series, nationally organized by WHU and RWTH Aachen. I was responsible for managing the student teams (around 30 students) and the relationships with old and new corporate sponsors, startup investors, mentors, and international university partners.

position.title: Intern at Global Consulting Practice
position.description:

I worked directly with the Head of Consulting Practice and got entrusted with researching and preparing the currently emerging topic of “Industry 4.0” as well as with the development of potential case studies. I was consequently staffed to participate in digitization projects and to contribute to sales proposals for leading German companies from different industries.

position.title: Intern

After completing multiple trainings and workshops in different Change Management theories and Scholar Consult’s methods in particular, I was staffed on a project with one of Japan’s leading infrastructure companies to help the company in its endeavors to internationalize.

position.title: Intern

I was trained in analyzing data from Google Analytics and was entrusted with finding new patterns for customer behavior in addition to managing my own Google AdWords budget. Additionally, through access to all purchase and inventory databases, I successfully built a cross-selling mechanism to match existing customers with potentially interesting books that directly yielded additional sales.

multiLocaleHeadline.en: I help business talent become useful in startups. I run WHU’s Entrepreneurship Center, connect founders with the right WHU alums, and write about ambition density and startup communities

multiLocaleSummary.de: Put 1,000 ambitious people in a roomand you still don’t get a great startup ecosystem. Because talent is not the bottleneck. Direction is. - People build the wrong things.- Talk to the wrong people.- Learn the same lessons twice. That’s the problem I work on. I’m Director of the Entrepreneurship Center at WHU.But what I actually do is build the operating layer of a startup community. - I connect people earlier.- I make patterns visible.- I turn stories into infrastructure. Because the best communities scale through: - shared memory - fast connections - and environments where ambition compounds  At WHU, I operate inside one of those environments:15 unicorns, a disproportionate share of venture capital, and a network where people actually reply. What drives this is something I think about a lot: Ambition density. Put enough ambitious people in one place,and the baseline shifts. An environment where doing something ambitious feels normal…and doing nothing starts to feel like a choice. I write about: - how founders actually find leverage - why business talent is underrated - how ecosystems shape outcomes - and why most advantages are structural, not individual  Because the real edge is rarely the idea.It’s understanding the game…and finding the right people to play it with.

data.summary: Woher weiß man wirklich, ob Fleisch noch frisch ist? Das Datum auf der Packung sagt es nicht – meine Technologie soll es sichtbar machen.Als Gründer von BioSignal entwickle ich eine bio-basierte, pH-reaktive Indikatorfolie für Fleischverpackungen. Sie zeigt die tatsächliche Frische über einen Farbwechsel an – grün, gelb, rot. Ohne Strom, ohne App, direkt am Regal ablesbar.Das Problem dahinter ist groß: Allein in Deutschland landen jährlich rund 346 Mio. kg Fleisch im Müll – häufig, weil das aufgedruckte Mindesthaltbarkeitsdatum nichts über den echten Zustand des Produkts aussagt. Genau hier setzt BioSignal an: weniger Verschwendung, mehr Lebensmittelsicherheit, ehrliche Information für Handel und Verbraucher. Unser Geschäftsmodell ist B2B – wir lizenzieren die Technologie an fleischverarbeitende Betriebe und Verpackungshersteller.Die Folie funktioniert bereits im Labor; aktuell arbeiten wir an der Validierung am echten Produkt und an der industriellen Reife.Mein Weg dorthin war ungewöhnlich: Vor dem Gründen stand ich vor der Kamera – als Schauspieler (Agentur Next Generation) und Model (Agentur McFit) in Film, Fernsehen und Werbekampagnen. Was ich dort gelernt habe – klar kommunizieren, eine Idee überzeugend transportieren, unter Druck souverän auftreten – nutze ich heute jeden Tag als Gründer.Ich freue mich über Austausch mit Menschen aus FoodTech, nachhaltiger Verpackung, Lebensmittelhandel und Forschung – ebenso über Anfragen rund um Schauspiel und Modeln.

position.title: Mitgründer
position.description:
BioSignal ist ein Deep-Tech-Startup mit Sitz in Neubeuern, Bayern. Wir entwickeln ein biobasiertes Smart-Label, das den Verderb von Fleisch in Echtzeit durch einen natürlichen Farbwechsel sichtbar macht – von Grün (frisch) zu Rot (verdorben). Kein Strom. Keine App. Nur Chemie, die für dich arbeitet.
Unser Ziel: 346 Millionen kg Fleischabfall jährlich in Deutschland reduzieren – mit einer 100 % kompostierbaren  Label.

position.title: Co-Founder
position.description:
In my 20s, I looked successful on the outside. Great logos on my CV, top business school, marathons…

But inside?

Imposter syndrome, comparison, the need to prove myself and self-doubt were running the show.

Business coaching and therapy changed that. They gave me the tools to understand myself better and redefine success on my own terms.

That’s why I started Deep Work: the community I wish I had back then.

We help founders & startup operators go deeper, beyond surface-level success.

In winter 2026, we’re opening the first Deep Work Clubhouse in Berlin. The gym for your mental fitness. A space to connect, reflect, grow and have conversations that go beyond traditional networking.

🌍 Mission: equipping 1 billion people with the tools & skills to master their thoughts, emotions and actions.

https://deepwork.club/

data.summary: Ich baue Systeme für kleine Unternehmen. Zwei Bereiche, ein Gedanke: Was Zeit frisst, automatisiere ich. Was Kunden bringt, baue ich.Ferienwohnungen. Ich automatisiere die Verwaltung: Abläufe, Kommunikation, Übergaben, Dokumentation. Das mache ich seit Jahren und weiterhin, für Betreiber, die ihre Zeit lieber in Gäste stecken als in Tabellen.Akquise. Beim Automatisieren ist mir aufgefallen, dass das eigentliche Problem meiner Kunden meist nicht die Verwaltung war, sondern der Vertrieb. Die Abläufe liefen, die Kunden fehlten. Daraus sind zwei Werkzeuge entstanden: LeadGun für digitale Akquise per E-Mail, und Kuchenakquise für den Fall, dass E-Mails nicht mehr ankommen. Ein Kuchen mit dem Logo des Wunschkunden, einer persönlichen Nachricht und einem QR-Code, der zeigt, wer wirklich interessiert ist. Wir nennen es Cold Caking.Warum das nötig ist: Kalte E-Mails werden zu drei Prozent geöffnet, und seit jede Nachricht von einer KI geschrieben sein kann, hat der Text an sich keinen Wert mehr. Was zählt, ist sichtbarer Aufwand.Wenn eines der beiden Themen bei Ihnen gerade ansteht, schreiben Sie mir.

position.description:
Als Werkstudent in der Domain Data & Analytics im Konzernprojekt SPACE bei E.ON Grid Solutions begleite ich agile Teams und Stakeholder intensiv bei der digitalen Transformation. Meine Rolle verbindet wirtschaftspsychologische Ansätze mit datenbasierter Prozessoptimierung, um die Effizienz der Zusammenarbeit nachhaltig zu steigern und administrative Hürden abzubauen.

Schwerpunkte & Projekterfolge:
• Agile Begleitung & Moderation: Eigenverantwortliche Steuerung von Scrum-Events und maßgeschneiderten Retrospektiven für verschiedene Teams im Projektkontext.
• Prozessautomatisierung & Datenanalyse: Konzeption und Personalisierung automatisierter Workflows (MS Lists, Power Automate) zur Reduzierung administrativer Aufwände sowie systematische Analyse von Sprint-Metriken zur Identifikation von Prozessoptimierungen.
• Großgruppen-Moderation & Transformation: Konzeption und interaktive Moderation standortübergreifender Events für fachübergreifende Data-Communities mit rund 50 Teilnehmenden sowie anschauliche Vermittlung psychologischer Konzepte in internen Foren.
• Workshops & Befähigung: Konzeption, Vorbereitung und Durchführung von zielgruppenspezifischen Workshops und Lernformaten zur kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung agiler Arbeitsweisen.

data.summary: I am driven by a simple question:How can we turn complexity into clear decisions and those decisions into impact?What fascinates me is the moment when something complicated starts to make sense. A messy set of information becomes a pattern, competing perspectives become priorities, and an unclear problem becomes a direction.Across my experiences in consulting, strategy, research, and execution, one conviction has become increasingly clear: analysis is only valuable if it leads somewhere. I enjoy understanding a problem deeply, but even more so translating that understanding into a decision and ultimately into action.This is why management consulting feels like a natural next step. It puts that mindset to work on unfamiliar business problems, where creating clarity quickly matters and recommendations ultimately have to work beyond the slide.At WHU – Otto Beisheim School of Management, where I am pursuing an M.Sc. in International Business, case-based learning continuously puts this thinking to the test: structure the problem, take a position, defend it, and refine it when a better argument emerges.The same principle shapes how I approach progress outside of work. Years of strength training and basketball have taught me to set ambitious goals, build the right process, execute consistently, and then raise the bar. Results compound when the process is right.Long term, I want to build the judgment to take on increasingly difficult business problems, create clarity when the path forward is unclear, and turn that clarity into lasting results.

data.summary: I've spent the last five years building and scaling operations in urban mobility – starting as one of Bolt's first hires in Germany and working up to General Manager, where I now co-run the Micromobility business across Germany.My work sits at the intersection of P&L ownership, operational complexity, and people leadership. I manage multi-market clusters with a focus on turning operational performance into commercial results.Before Bolt, I ran the administrative and management backbone of a Frankfurt-based agency as its first business hire – covering finance, HR, legal, and strategy while the company scaled. That experience shaped how I think about building things from scratch.I think of myself as an operator with an entrepreneurial streak – I don't wait for direction, I find the problem and move. Decisions without a data foundation make me uncomfortable. Five roles in five years have kept me adaptable by necessity – and I've come to prefer it that way.On the side I am building together with like-minded peers or advising founders and early-stage ventures.

position.title: CEO
position.description:
Taxfix is Europe’s leading AI-native financial platform for digital tax solutions, with over 8 million tax returns submitted and more than €4.5 billion in refunds reclaimed. Taxfix mission is to empower people to take control of their finances and fix finance for all. Powered by scalable technology, integrated AI, and user-centric design, Taxfix turns one of life’s most complex, stressful tasks – filing taxes – into a simple, secure, and personalised experience.
The platform, with its brands Taxfix and Steuerbot, offers AI-powered tax filing for diverse needs: intuitive self-filing with guided Q&A, expert services with certified tax advisors managing the entire process, and specialised financial services for the self-employed. For Taxfix’ tax accountant partners, the platform provides smart tools, automation, and AI-driven workflows for efficient, high-quality delivery at scale.
With offices in Berlin, London, Madrid, and Tallinn, Taxfix serves millions across Germany, the UK, and Spain and employs over 400 professionals from more than 50 nationalities. The company is backed by leading investors including Index Ventures, Valar Ventures, Creandum, Redalpine, and Teachers’ Venture Growth (OTPP).

position.title: Board Member
position.description: Bringing big smiles to little people - Afrikids vision is to empower the local communities to make sustainable changes themselves so that every child in Ghana is protected, educated and can lead a happy and healthy life without poverty. Afrkids works together with local communities to end harmful traditional practices and protect children and girls in particular, while respecting local culture and environment to build a long lasting and self-sustainable foundation for change through programmes in child protection, education and health.

position.title: Co-CEO
position.description: Disrupting the traditional money remittance space Skrill Group (formerly Moneybookers) was an early pioneer in offering global P2P money transfer and digital payment & fraud solutions. Growing its base to over 30 million digital wallets Skrill became one of Europe's leading and fastest growing fintech unicorns at the time with 600+ employees based in London, Sofia, New York, Berlin, Stockholm, and Singapore.  Winning numerous awards (e.g. #1 fastest growing private equity backed company by profit by the Sunday Times) it grew organically and through acquisitions (e.g. Payolution, Paysafe Card). Backed by Investcorp the group was sold to Optimal Payments Group and is today called Paysafe Group (listed on NYSE: PSFE).

Responsible for starting and growing the consumer business, as well as the global country operations and content development across Europe, APAC, North and South America to over $500m in revenues and $150M EBITDA. Backed by Summit Partners it was sold to Verisign Inc. in 2004 (NASDAQ: VRSN), and entered into a JV with News Corp (Fox Interactive) owning the majority in 2006.

position.title: Associate Director Strategy
position.description:
Reporting directly to both Co-Founders with cross-functional responsibility for strategic initiatives, organizational development and operational scalability. Equivalent to a Chief-of-Staff function with more operational focus. 

Key Achievements:
- Drove full automation of core delivery processes, cutting process times by nearly 90 % and improving candidate completeness by 50 %+
- Led the automation of talent pre-qualification and outreach, boosting booking rates by +150 %, enabling 30 % more candidate conversions and same-day qualification, increasing candidate NPS to 8.3/10
- Integrated an acquired company into Empion's product and operational ecosystem, unifying workflow and systems
- Co-led Product Team initiatives: drafted wireframes, defined features and oversaw implementation of core product modules
- Designed and launched two new departments (Customer Success & Talent Scouts), including structure, onboarding, tooling and performance reporting
- Introduced an OKR-based operating system and leadership meeting cascade, enhancing alignment and execution speed
- Re-defined company Vision, Mission & Values to align leadership and teams around a single growth narrative
- Built an internal analytics framework for performance tracking across operations and delivery

position.title: Head of Sales
position.description:
Procuros connects companies with all of their trading partners digitally — whether they use EDI, PDF, or CSV. AI-powered workflows automatically fix errors, enrich data, and keep everything transparent for business users. The result: the most admin-light way to manage trading partner relationships.
With over €2B processed annually and backing from Point Nine and Creandum, we're on a mission to put the Supply Chain on Autopilot.

Leading Sales and Customer Success globally.

position.title: Head of Sales
position.description:
octonomy finally brings AI to companies with complex, high-touch products and services. 

While most AI solutions are focussed on easy tasks (eg where is my order, how can I login) or rely on perfect data sets to still only answer simple, recurring questions, octonomy transforms your company knowledge into an experts system and enables you to automate service interactions and other business processes with > 96 % precision.

Spread company knowledge? Product information that contain tables, graphs or charts standard AI just can't work with? Complex processes and tools you believe are just not ready yet for real business impact with AI? Let us show you what's already possible today.

Personally responsible for sales including SDRs, AE's and SE's.

position.title: Head of Sales DACH
position.description:
Since joining Personio in 2019, I was able to support the hyper growth journey from 300 employees and 300 M$ valuation to 2.500 employees and a valuation of 8.5 B$.

Promoted into a 2nd line leadership role 
Leading 5 managers working with teams of net new revenue Account Executives focussing on mid market / lower enterprise Germany, Austria & Switzerland and .org / public combined representing the number 1 net new revenue contributor in the organisation.
Global Strategic Pillar "Win Mid Market" Representative with leaders from product, partnerships, CX and management to create business focus on high impact initiatives.

position.title: Manager Sales
position.description:
Built and led Personio's first mid market / lower enterprise team
Hired, led and coached up to 12 Account Executives focussing on net new customer acquisition
Given the previously strong company focus on SMBs, I contributed to creating a strong outbound motion, adapting to more complex buying processes and buying centers (eg. implemented MEDDICC and new sales motions dealing with IT driven projects as well as collaboration with Solution Engineering, Tech Partnerships and Marketing) and had a high focus on training and developing the team to be set up for success in that space. 

Helped to transform mid market from early beginnings to the number 1 net new revenue contributor in the business with further investments in headcount and product.

position.title: Head of Sales Germany
position.description:
GoCardless, supported by investors like Permira and BlackRock Private Equity Partners (total invest $540 M ; valuation USD 2.1 billion) is a leading fintech in direct bank payment solutions. 
GoCardless processes more than $25bn in transactions per year and serves over 70,000 businesses around the world, including DocuSign, Klarna, TripAdvisor and Epson.

Alberto Riva, Principal at Permira: “We believe GoCardless is uniquely positioned to become a global champion in account-to-account payments through leveraging open banking. We are thrilled to back Hiroki and his excellent team to continue innovating and offering best-in-class solutions that are cheaper, faster and a more secure way of collecting payments globally.”

honors.title: EXIST Gründungsstipendium
honors.description: EXIST-Gründungsstipendium ist ein Förderprogramm des Bundesministeriums für Wirtschaft und Klimaschutz (BMWK) und wird durch den Europäischen Sozialfonds (ESF) kofinanziert. Das Programm unterstützt innovative, technologieorientierte Gründungsvorhaben aus Hochschulen und außeruniversitären Forschungseinrichtungen. Die Förderung umfasst ein Jahr Unterstützung mit Lebenshaltungskosten für bis zu drei Gründer:innen, Sachmittel und Coaching. Ziel ist es, wissensbasierte Gründungsideen bis zur technischen Machbarkeit und Marktfähigkeit zu entwickeln und einen tragfähigen Businessplan zu erstellen.

honors.title: Hessen Ideen Stipendium
honors.description:
Das Hessen Ideen Stipendium ist ein sechsmonatiges Stipendienprogramm für gründungsaffine Hochschulangehörige bzw. –absolvent:innen, die sich in einer frühen Phase der Ausarbeitung einer innovativen, wissensbasierten unternehmerischen Geschäftsidee befinden. Gründungsteams aus hessischen Hochschulen sollen während des Stipendiums beim Übergang von einer ersten unternehmerischen Idee zu einem validierten Geschäftskonzept unterstützt werden.

Die Förderung besteht aus zwei Elementen - einer finanziellen Förderung sowie einem begleitenden Akzeleratorprogramm.
honors.issuer: Hessisches Ministerium für Wissenschaft und Forschung, Kunst und Kultur (HMWK)

honors.title: SENovation Award 2024 (Vorgründer-Kategorie)
honors.description: Der SENovation Award ist ein Wettbewerb für innovative Startups und Gründungskonzepte im Bereich Silver Economy. Das Programm richtet sich an Teams die Lösungen für und mit der Generation 65+ entwickeln. In einem mehrstufigen Auswahlprozess werden alle geeigneten Bewerbungen von einem Online-Panel mit mehr als 1.000 Seniorinnen und Senioren bewertet, bevor im Finale in Dortmund eine Expert:innen-Jury aus Wirtschaft, Forschung und Demografie entscheidet. Als Gewinnerteams erhielten wir Preisgeld sowie individuelles Coaching.

data.headline: CEO bei Bluda

position.title: Software Scientist
position.description: Developed a real-time image-stitching algorithm for ESP32-S3 microcontrollers, reducing image-pair processing time from 672 ms to approximately 3 ms and reaching around 27 FPS. Researched an efficient method for real-time document scanning on resource-constrained embedded hardware. Built a dimensionality-reduction approach converting 2D image data into 1D brightness fingerprints and using cross-correlation for offset detection. Prototyped the algorithm in Python with OpenCV and NumPy, then ported performance-critical logic to C++. Optimized runtime through static memory allocation, caching, compiler optimization, and CPU frequency tuning.

position.title: Lead Software Engineer
position.description: Developed a text-based vertical video editing software designed to streamline narrative building for large-scale documentary projects. Engineered an AI-ready workflow for processing and organizing large volumes of dialogue, successfully tested on 180+ hours of raw footage. Implemented FCP7 XML export for synchronization of cuts and subtitles with DaVinci Resolve and Premiere Pro.

position.title: Founder
position.description: Built a complete hardware/software product ecosystem including custom PCB prototypes, embedded firmware, mechanical design, a Flutter mobile app, Go backend, product website, and online shop. Developed Bluda Mark, a cloud-connected embedded device in the form factor of a text marker. Designed, built, and tested six hardware prototype versions, including PCB design, manual soldering, mechanical design, and 3D prototyping. Developed the mobile companion app in Flutter/Dart and published it to the Apple App Store through Xcode. Built backend infrastructure in Go and developed the product website/shop using Next.js, Astro, and Medusa.js. Prepared CE-related technical documentation, frequency analysis materials, and coordinated prototype sourcing with international suppliers.

position.title: Founder
position.description: Founded and built an education technology platform for music learning, actively used in school environments. Designed interactive browser-based tools for note reading, intervals, ear training, rhythm, and virtual piano exercises. Built teacher workflows for class progress tracking, assignments, student feedback, and QR-supported worksheet generation. Developed the platform using Svelte, Astro, and Convex.

data.summary:
Als Gründer und Geschäftsführer von doppelt.digital und Denk doch Digital vereine ich meine Leidenschaft für Technologie mit meinem unternehmerischen Geist. Ich habe eine Ausbildung zum Fachinformatiker im Bereich Anwendungsentwicklung abgeschlossen und mich seitdem auf DevOps- und Apps-Entwicklung spezialisiert.

Bei doppelt.digital biete ich erstklassige DevOps-Dienstleistungen an, die Kunden dabei helfen, ihre Softwareentwicklungs- und Bereitstellungsprozesse zu optimieren. Wir haben Erfahrung in der Implementierung und Verwaltung von Cloud-Infrastrukturen, Automatisierungslösungen und Sicherheitsmaßnahmen. Mit meinem Unternehmen Denk doch Digital entwickle ich innovative Apps mit Flutter, die von tausenden von Nutzern geschätzt werden. Eine unserer erfolgreichsten Apps ist "KVB Live Fahrplan", die den öffentlichen Nahverkehr in Köln erleichtert.

Mein Ziel ist es, mit meinen Unternehmen eine Brücke zwischen Technologie und gesellschaftlichem Fortschritt zu schlagen. Ich glaube fest daran, dass Technologie ein Werkzeug ist, um positive Veränderungen in unserer Welt zu bewirken. Ich setze mich dafür ein, dass Innovationen zum Wohl der Gesellschaft eingesetzt werden.

items.title: Konzeption & Entwicklung der App KVB Live Fahrplan und anderen Live-Fahrplan Apps
items.description:
Bei diesem Projekt handelt es sich um eine App, die die Live-Abfahrtszeiten der Kölner Verkehrs-Betriebe AG (KVB) anzeigt. Hierfür werden offizielle Datenquellen der Stadt Köln mit inoffiziellen Daten von der Webseite der KVB kombiniert.

Der Tech-Stack umfasst Python für das Backend, Elasticsearch & Kibana für die Datenanalyse, Docker & Linux für das Hosting, Flutter / Dart für die iOS & Android App, Angular für die Web-App / PWA und Google Firebase & Analytics für die Datenanalyse der App sowie A/B-Tests, etc.

Aufgrund des schnellen Erfolgs der App in Köln (~100.000 Downloads / mehrmals unter den Top 50 im App-Store) habe ich mich entschieden, weitere Apps in diesem Bereich zu entwickeln. Diese nutzen dieselbe Code-Basis, wobei ein spezielles Dart-Package entwickelt wurde, das es ermöglicht, mit nur wenigen Zeilen Code für nahezu jede Großstadt eine solche App zu veröffentlichen. Allerdings erfordert jede App ein eigenes Backend, da viele Städte unterschiedliche Standards verwenden (GTFS, GTFS-RT, etc.). Die meisten dieser Backend-Anwendungen sind Docker-Container mit einer NestJS-Anwendung.

multiLocaleSummary.de:
Als Gründer und Geschäftsführer von doppelt.digital und Denk doch Digital vereine ich meine Leidenschaft für Technologie mit meinem unternehmerischen Geist. Ich habe eine Ausbildung zum Fachinformatiker im Bereich Anwendungsentwicklung abgeschlossen und mich seitdem auf DevOps- und Apps-Entwicklung spezialisiert.

Bei doppelt.digital biete ich erstklassige DevOps-Dienstleistungen an, die Kunden dabei helfen, ihre Softwareentwicklungs- und Bereitstellungsprozesse zu optimieren. Wir haben Erfahrung in der Implementierung und Verwaltung von Cloud-Infrastrukturen, Automatisierungslösungen und Sicherheitsmaßnahmen. Mit meinem Unternehmen Denk doch Digital entwickle ich innovative Apps mit Flutter, die von tausenden von Nutzern geschätzt werden. Eine unserer erfolgreichsten Apps ist "KVB Live Fahrplan", die den öffentlichen Nahverkehr in Köln erleichtert.

Mein Ziel ist es, mit meinen Unternehmen eine Brücke zwischen Technologie und gesellschaftlichem Fortschritt zu schlagen. Ich glaube fest daran, dass Technologie ein Werkzeug ist, um positive Veränderungen in unserer Welt zu bewirken. Ich setze mich dafür ein, dass Innovationen zum Wohl der Gesellschaft eingesetzt werden.

data.summary:
Mein akademischer Hintergrund umfasst ein abgeschlossenes Bachelorstudium im Bereich Finance & Banking an der FOM Hochschule für Oekonomie & Management. Derzeit arbeite ich als Senior Unternehmerkundenberater bei der Commerzbank AG, wo ich mich auf eine ganzheitliche, bedarfsorientierte Beratung von Unternehmern spezialisiere. Meine Kernkompetenzen sind Finanzierungsberatung, Vermögensverwaltungsleistungen und umfassende Lösungen in den Bereichen Zahlungsverkehr, Absicherung und Vorsorge.  

Bei der Commerzbank arbeite ich daran, durch aktive Kundenansprache und den Ausbau von Kundenbeziehungen nachhaltige Werte für unsere Kunden zu schaffen. Mein Ziel ist es, sowohl bestehende Kundenbeziehungen zu stärken als auch durch gezielte Neukundenakquise unser Netzwerk zu erweitern. Dabei motiviert mich, innovative Finanzlösungen bereitzustellen, die den individuellen Bedürfnissen unserer Kunden gerecht werden, und gleichzeitig innerhalb eines dynamischen Teams verschiedene Perspektiven einzubringen.

data.summary: I’m an Enterprise Solution Architect with more than 10 years of experience spanning enterprise consulting, software engineering, AI product development and entrepreneurship. My work combines enterprise architecture, solution strategy, technical leadership and hands-on engineering. At Tata Consultancy Services, I lead technical discovery, presales, solution architecture and executive workshops for enterprise clients across DACH and Europe. My focus is helping organizations adopt AI pragmatically by identifying where it creates measurable business value while balancing architecture, security, governance and delivery. Alongside my consulting career, I founded and launched two AI products from concept to production. multiLocaleSummary.de:
Mit über 15 Jahren Erfahrung in Softwareentwicklung, Systemarchitektur und Automatisierung – davon mehr als 8 Jahre mit Schwerpunkt auf Salesforce Marketing Cloud – konzipiere und realisiere ich skalierbare und leistungsfähige Lösungen für Unternehmen aus unterschiedlichsten Branchen.

Als Salesforce Marketing Cloud Architekt und Senior Consultant war ich an zahlreichen Projekten über den gesamten Lebenszyklus hinweg beteiligt, von der technischen Architektur und dem Solution Design bis hin zum produktiven Betrieb, unter Einsatz agiler Methoden und bewährter Best Practices. Darüber hinaus habe ich individuelle Integrationen und Plattform-Erweiterungen unter anderem mit XML, PHP und Android entwickelt, um komplexe Marketing- und Datenprozesse zu unterstützen.

In früheren Positionen als Senior Software Engineer und Consultant habe ich umfangreiche Erfahrung in der Umsetzung von Salesforce-Marketing-Cloud-Lösungen gesammelt, insbesondere in den Bereichen E-Mail-Marketing, Customer Journey Orchestrierung, Datenmodellierung und -analyse sowie Marketing-Automatisierung im Enterprise-Umfeld.

Ich unterstütze Unternehmen mit großer Leidenschaft dabei, Salesforce Marketing Cloud effizient einzusetzen, um messbare Marketingerfolge zu erzielen und das Kundenerlebnis nachhaltig zu verbessern. Mein Anspruch an kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung zeigt sich unter anderem in meinen Zertifizierungen als ScrumMaster sowie als Salesforce Marketing Cloud Email Specialist und Developer.

Ich schätze Zusammenarbeit, technische Exzellenz und nachhaltigen Business-Mehrwert und arbeite gerne an anspruchsvollen Herausforderungen im Bereich Marketing-Technologie und Automatisierung.
multiLocaleSummary.en: I’m an Enterprise Solution Architect with more than 10 years of experience spanning enterprise consulting, software engineering, AI product development and entrepreneurship. Throughout my career I’ve helped organizations translate complex business challenges into scalable technical solutions. My work combines enterprise architecture, solution strategy, technical leadership and hands-on engineering. At Tata Consultancy Services, I lead technical discovery, presales, solution architecture and executive workshops for enterprise clients across DACH and Europe. My focus is helping organizations adopt AI pragmatically by identifying where it creates measurable business value while balancing architecture, security, governance and delivery. Alongside my consulting career, I founded and launched two AI products from concept to production. This gave me hands-on experience with customer discovery, product strategy, LLM architecture, production operations and commercial validation. What makes my profile different is the combination of consulting, architecture and engineering. I enjoy discussing business strategy with executives, designing enterprise architectures with architects and still being close enough to technology to build working solutions with engineering teams. Areas I enjoy working on: Enterprise Solution ArchitectureAI TransformationTechnical Product LeadershipEnterprise IntegrationPresales and Solution StrategyAI Product ArchitectureLLM Applications and Agentic Workflows I’m always interested in connecting with people working on enterprise architecture, AI transformation and complex technology challenges.
multiLocaleSummary.fr:
Avec plus de 15 ans d’expérience en développement logiciel, architecture de systèmes et automatisation, dont plus de 8 ans spécialisés sur Salesforce Marketing Cloud, je conçois et déploie des solutions évolutives et à forte valeur ajoutée pour des organisations de divers secteurs.

En tant qu’Architecte Salesforce Marketing Cloud et Senior Consultant, j’ai participé à de nombreux projets de bout en bout, depuis l’architecture technique et la conception des solutions jusqu’au déploiement en production, en appliquant des méthodologies agiles et les meilleures pratiques du secteur. J’ai également développé des intégrations personnalisées et des extensions de plateforme en utilisant notamment XML, PHP et Android afin de prendre en charge des flux marketing et data complexes.

Au cours de mes précédentes fonctions de Senior Software Engineer et Consultant, j’ai acquis une solide expérience dans la mise en œuvre de solutions Salesforce Marketing Cloud, notamment pour l’email marketing, l’orchestration des parcours clients, la modélisation et l’analyse des données, ainsi que l’automatisation marketing à grande échelle.

Je suis passionné par l’accompagnement des entreprises dans l’utilisation efficace de Salesforce Marketing Cloud afin d’obtenir des résultats marketing mesurables et d’améliorer durablement l’expérience client. Je m’engage également dans une démarche d’amélioration continue, comme en témoignent mes certifications ScrumMaster ainsi que Salesforce Marketing Cloud Email Specialist et Developer.

J’accorde une grande importance à la collaboration, à l’excellence technique et à l’impact business concret, et j’apprécie relever des défis complexes dans l’écosystème des technologies marketing et de l’automatisation.

educations.description: Im Rahmen meines englischsprachigen Bachelorstudiums 'International Business Management' habe ich in den ersten drei Semestern eine fundierte betriebswirtschaftliche Basis erworben. Zu den zentralen Inhalten zählten International Business und Strategisches Management, Buchhaltung, Kostenrechnung, Internationales Wirtschaftsrecht sowie Finanz- und Investitionsplanung. Ergänzt wurden diese durch volkswirtschaftliche Grundlagen in Mikro- und Makroökonomie sowie Quantitative Methoden wie Statistik und Datenanalyse. Einen besonderen Schwerpunkt bildete die Praxisorientierung, beispielsweise im 'Advanced Practical Project,' bei dem wir in enger Zusammenarbeit mit einem SaaS-Unternehmen Marktforschung betrieben und praxisrelevante Lösungen entwickelten. Diese Kombination aus Theorie und Praxis legte den Grundstein für ein breites Verständnis internationaler Wirtschaftszusammenhänge. Das Hauptstudium bestand aus zwei Auslandsemestern an Partneruniversitäten in Australien und Malaysia.

data.summary:
Zahnarzt I Founder I Innovator 

Als Zahnarzt und ehemaliger Angstpatient habe ich die Lücke zwischen wissenschaftlicher Zahnmedizin und den individuellen Bedürfnissen meiner Patienten erkannt.

In unserem Startup entwickeln wir eine individualisierte Zahnpasta, zugeschnitten auf die Bedürfnisse und Vorlieben des Einzelnen. Unsere personalisierte Lösung vereint zahnmedizinisches und pharmazeutisches Wissen mit moderner Technologie, um eine positive Erfahrung von Mund- und Körperpflege zu schaffen. Gleichzeitig wollen wir unsere Kunden individuell und einfühlsam zu ihren zahnmedizinischen Problemen und Fragen beraten. Denn ein aufgeklärter Kunde ist ein mündiger Patient! Mehr zu wissen, bedeutet, die Angst vor dem Zahnarzt oder der Behandlung zu verlieren - ein Thema, welches mir besonders am Herzen liegt.

Interessiert an der Zukunft der Zahnpflege? Folge mir für weitere Updates und Einblicke in unser Projekt!

multiLocaleSummary.de:
Zahnarzt I Founder I Innovator 

Als Zahnarzt und ehemaliger Angstpatient habe ich die Lücke zwischen wissenschaftlicher Zahnmedizin und den individuellen Bedürfnissen meiner Patienten erkannt.

In unserem Startup entwickeln wir eine individualisierte Zahnpasta, zugeschnitten auf die Bedürfnisse und Vorlieben des Einzelnen. Unsere personalisierte Lösung vereint zahnmedizinisches und pharmazeutisches Wissen mit moderner Technologie, um eine positive Erfahrung von Mund- und Körperpflege zu schaffen. Gleichzeitig wollen wir unsere Kunden individuell und einfühlsam zu ihren zahnmedizinischen Problemen und Fragen beraten. Denn ein aufgeklärter Kunde ist ein mündiger Patient! Mehr zu wissen, bedeutet, die Angst vor dem Zahnarzt oder der Behandlung zu verlieren - ein Thema, welches mir besonders am Herzen liegt.

Interessiert an der Zukunft der Zahnpflege? Folge mir für weitere Updates und Einblicke in unser Projekt!

position.title: Founder
position.description:
Ola is a personal AI agent that browses the web, calls businesses on your behalf, builds any app, gets things done for you, is proactive and knows you intimately. Currently in Beta.

The future of technology is agentic. Everything we do with PCs, Phones, Apps, or on the internet will be done by one personal Agent. Ola is that Agent.

position.title: Co-Founder
position.description:
Manual execution is too slow for modern markets. At Wealth AI, we are building the solution: fully automated, institutional-grade infrastructure designed for Max Profit // Min Effort.

We deliver outcomes, not just tools. Our AI autonomously manages strategy creation and removes emotional bias

We operate on radical alignment: if you don’t profit, we extend your service for free until you do.

position.title: Intern
position.description:
I had the privilege of serving as the youngest intern of Deka’s Quantitative Asset Management branch.

During my time on the Frankfurt trading floor, I was embedded within the Alternative Strategies team, gaining deep exposure to:

Systematic Alpha Generation: Analyzed institutional-grade quantitative models and the integration of Machine Learning in multi-asset frameworks.

Derivative & Fixed Income Analytics: Developed a granular understanding of Options pricing/hedging and Bond portfolio optimization within a large-scale asset manager.

Institutional Execution: Worked in direct proximity to senior Quants and Traders, observing the mechanics of high-volume execution and risk management protocols.


This experience solidified my foundation in Market Microstructure and Quantitative Research.

multiLocaleSummary.de: Ich entwickle AI-Produkte, die Dinge für Menschen erledigen, statt nur Fragen zu beantworten. Ich bin 17 und lebe in der Nähe von Frankfurt. Founder von Ola, einem persönlichen AI Agent, der das Web durchsucht, Leute und Unternehmen anruft, Apps baut, Dinge für dich erledigt, proaktiv handelt und dich intim kennt. Aktuell in Beta. Co-Founder von Wealth AI, einer automatisierten Crypto-Trading-Plattform, bei der Nutzer ihr Risikolevel festlegen, eine Exchange verbinden und das System für sie traden lassen. Live mit echten Nutzern. Ich bin gut darin, ambitionierte Ideen schnell in funktionierende Produkte zu verwandeln und AI im großen rahmen einzusetzen. Mein Multi-Agent-Setup schreibt, testet und deployed Code und lässt dabei bis zu Hunderte Agents parallel laufen. Zuvor Praktika bei JPMorgan und bei Deka Investment im Quantitative Asset Management und Capital Markets. Ich entwickle und investiere seit meinem 13. Lebensjahr.
multiLocaleSummary.en: I build AI products that do things for people instead of just answering questions. I’m 17, based near Frankfurt.Founder of Ola, a personal AI agent that browses the web, calls businesses and people on your behalf, builds any app, gets things done for you, is proactive and knows you intimately. Currently in Beta.Co-Founder of Wealth AI, an automated crypto trading platform where users set their risk level, connect an exchange, and let the system trade for them. Live with users.I’m good at turning ambitious ideas into products fast and building with AI at scale. My multi-agent setup writes, tests, and ships code, running up to hundreds of Agents in parallel.Previously interned at JPMorgan and Deka Investment’s Quantitative Asset Management desk and Capital Markets. Trading/investing since 12 and building software since 14.

profile.startup_one_liner: Your OS may be secure. But is your hardware talking?

data.summary: Most cyber security strategies start at the operating system.But hardware can be compromised long before software defenses notice anything.Over the last 30+ years, I’ve worked in Cyber Security leadership roles across critical infrastructure, industrial environments and international enterprises, including KARL STORZ, Schindler and Volkswagen.Throughout my career, I’ve been building security strategies, leading teams and dealing with real-world risks where failure is not an option.Again and again, I saw the same blind spot:Security teams focus heavily on software and operating systems, while hardware-related threats and supply chain risks remain difficult to detect.That’s why we founded BRIGHTCYTE.We’re building technology focused on hardware trust, supply chain security and detecting hidden communication beyond the OS.If you work in critical infrastructure, industrial environments, defense or enterprise security and are facing similar challenges, feel free to reach out or schedule an exchange below. ⬇️Learn more: www.brightcyte.de
data.headline: Cyber Security beyond the Operating System | Hardware Trust & Supply Chain Security | Founder @ BRIGHTCYTE

position.title: Founder & CEO
position.description:
Building technology focused on hardware-level threat detection, supply chain security and hidden communication outside the operating system.

Focused on making hardware trust more transparent and helping organizations detect cyber security risks traditional OS-based approaches often miss.

position.title: Chief Information Security Officer
position.description:
Head of the Information and Cyber Security Department in KARL STORZ, responsible for the overall information and cyber security strategy, governance, and security risk management of our medical devices, software products, projects, IT infrastructure, and third parties.

✔️ Leadership: Founded and leading the Information and Cyber Security department, overseeing several specialized sub-departments.

✔️ Global Strategy: Orchestrated the global Information and Cyber Security Strategy and Tactics, impacting 60+ entities worldwide.

✔️ ISO 27001 Certification: Implemented an extensive Information Security Program, driving 30+ projects to achieve ISO 27001 certification across the organization.

✔️ Regulatory Initiatives: Influential in committees enhancing domestic, European, and international security regulations.

✔️ Incident Management: Directed comprehensive incident response and recovery efforts, ensuring minimal disruption and swift mitigation.

position.title: Manager Cyber Security Competence Center
position.description:
Head of the Cyber Security Competence Center, with global responsibility for the cyber security of Schindler’s digital products, the risk management of global IT and IoT projects, mobile security, and secure ICT architecture.

✔️ Team Leadership: Managed a international team of of risk analysts, security architects, penetration testers, and project managers.

✔️ Risk Management: Developed and implemented a global IT and IoT risk assessment methodology and strategy.

✔️ Third Party Risk Management: Responsible for the global third party risk management process, monitoring the global supply chain security.

✔️ Security Standards: Established global security standards and guidelines, ensuring consistent and robust security practices.

items.description:
2nd place Startup Challenge - theHackLab

Co-founded a startup concept for a managed transaction platform connecting mid-size industrial companies with academic researchers through structured contract workflows. Designed the go-to-market strategy targeting Lombardy's manufacturing corridor (EUR 10M–100M companies), built the bottom-up market-sizing model (EUR 35M routed contract value by Year 5), and developed a three-phase product roadmap from low-friction consulting engagements to full sponsored research infrastructure.

items.title: Bocconi Buddy - AI assistant for Bocconi students
items.description:
Bocconi AI Hackathon · Solo project

Built a working RAG assistant in six hours using Codex as a pair programmer. It answers the questions Bocconi students actually search for (housing, exchange, careers, campus) pulling from a curated dataset of public university sources via a FAISS vector index, and citing its sources. Designed it to refuse to answer when retrieved context wasn't relevant enough, treating "I don't know" as a feature.

data.headline: Windows Cloud Solution Engineer @ Microsoft | Windows 365 & Azure Virtual Desktop | Co-founder, Windows Cloud Academy 🏆

position.title: Windows Cloud Solution Engineer
position.description:
As a Windows Cloud Solution Engineer at Microsoft, I help enterprise customers in Germany modernize their workplace with Windows 365, Azure Virtual Desktop, and Microsoft Intune, simplifying device management, securing endpoints, and moving beyond legacy VDI.

A growing part of this role is bringing AI into the cloud workplace: building agents with Copilot Studio and enabling Windows 365 as a secure, managed environment for Computer-Using Agent (CUA) workloads.

As co-founder and co-leader of the Windows Cloud Academy, recognized with Microsoft's Windows Cloud Growth & Adoption Award 🏆. I drive technical enablement across the team, keeping our engineers sharp and our customers ahead of the curve.

I also stay close to the product group, bringing field insights back to Redmond to help shape where Windows in the cloud is headed next.

position.title: Cloud Solution Architect for Azure Infrastructure

multiLocaleTitle.de_DE: Cloud Solution Architect for Azure Infrastructure

position.description:
As a Cloud Solution Architect for Azure Infrastructure, I specialize in designing and delivering secure, scalable, and high-performance cloud solutions across enterprise environments. As the Practice Lead for Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD) in Germany, I drive strategic adoption and technical excellence in virtual desktop infrastructure. My work also spans Windows 365, where I help customers bridge cloud and hybrid work scenarios with modern, user-centric solutions. I collaborate closely with stakeholders to accelerate digital transformation, modernize infrastructure, and ensure long-term success of Windows in the Cloud.

Co-founder of the blog avdpunks.com

position.title: Senior Customer Engineer - Azure Apps & Infrastructure

multiLocaleTitle.de_DE: Senior Customer Engineer - Azure Apps & Infrastructure

position.description:
As a Customer Engineer for Azure Apps & Infrastructure, I provide in-depth technical knowledge and experience for enterprise customers in EMEA. I focused on the architecture and design of end-user computing / VDI infrastructures based on Azure Virtual Desktop and Remote Desktop Services on Windows Server. I also manage devices using Microsoft Endpoint Manager, including app protection design and per-app VPN concepts.

I am developing intellectual property (IP) content for an Azure Virtual Desktop workshop to enable more customers to use Azure Virtual Desktop as a VDI solution. I also communicate this knowledge to our customers in EMEA. 

I work directly with the product group in internal communities to improve the product.

position.title: Senior Consultant
position.description:
The adventure at braincon GmbH as a senior consultant began with the establishment of a new company location in Wuppertal, NRW. This location started with only two employees and zero customer engagements, so we started completely from scratch. We pushed the new focus location for Application Networking to win more customers in the first months. At this time I focused on PreSales and building new customer relationships that was exciting to win more customer with our company story.

At this point, I would like to especially thank Sascha Zimmer (CEO), Andreas Huther (CEO) and Thorsten Rood (CTO) for the opportunity to help write this company history. After 3 years, we have multiple customers from different industries for application networking projects, it has grown rapidly.

As a Senior Consultant, I focused on application network architecture with Citrix NetScaler / ADC while providing best practices and tools to meet customer needs. That also included Mobile Devices Management and Mobile App Management projects for thousands of end devices (iOS / Android) with Citrix XenMobile and Microsoft Intune. 

In February 2021, I was awarded the Citrix Technology Advocate (CTA) program for my work in the community helping the community improve their environments.

position.title: Co-Founder
position.description:
Our idea was simple: take the HelloFresh model and apply it to sewing. Just as meal kits deliver every ingredient for a recipe in one box, sewPack delivered everything needed for a garment (pattern, fabric, and thread) in one sustainable package.
 
Co-founded and ran sewPack end-to-end together with my co-founder Fabian Bialowons, with sustainability at the core: GOTS-certified organic fabrics, thread from 100% recycled polyester, and biodegradable packaging, sourced regionally wherever possible. As a two-person team, I covered everything from product and supplier relationships to brand, online shop, and partnerships with sewing bloggers and influencers. Recognized as "Start-up of the Month" by Textil+Mode (01/2019).
 
A great run, and a steep learning curve on building a physical-product business from scratch.

position.title: Technical Consultant - Application Networking
position.description:
As a technical consultant for application networking, I no longer focused on end-user computing technology, but on remote access architecture. How can users access their virtual apps, web apps and virtual desktops securely and quickly. 

Apply technical knowledge and customer insight to create architecture for Citrix Netscaler / ADC environments (HDX Gateway, SSL VPN, Load Balancing, Reverse Proxy). That included Microsoft TMG Replacement projects for secure publishing of Microsoft Exchange Services. 

In addition, I planned and deployed an architecture for a mobile device management solution (Citrix XenMobile) at the customer site to manage many iOS and Android devices. 

Designed solutions to meet business and IT needs for SMB and Enterprise customers with more than 55,000 users.

I was also involved in pre-sales customer meetings and PoC implementations to find the best solution for their business needs.

position.title: Junior Consultant
position.description: As a Junior Consultant at acentrix GmbH, I focused on the technical design, setup and operation of the Citrix Virtual Desktop infrastructure and supported one of the largest Citrix customers in Germany. The project consisted of providing the best optimized VDI desktop solution to every user and every customer. Provisioning of virtual desktops is based on Golden Master Imaging via Citrix Provisioning Services

position.title: IT-Consultant
position.description:
As an IT consultant at BIN-Control GmbH, I was mainly involved in end-user computing technology with Windows Server Remote Desktop Services, including Citrix Presentation Server / XenApp.

Apply technical knowledge and customer insight to create an architecture for Citrix environments using Citrix Provisioning Services for Golden Master Imaging and Deployment. 

I helped small and medium-sized companies to optimize their environments and migrate their physical servers to a virtualization environment (XenServer or VMWare Solution).

I’ve been involved in projects across branding, website development, design, UX/UI, and consultancy services; the area where I naturally thrive. I only take on projects when I have the bandwidth, allowing me to focus fully and deliver my best work.

position.title: Project Manager
position.description:
What an experience it was working at Kurieta.
Huge thanks to Vikrant (the founder) for seeing potential beyond titles and years of experience. When I first applied, the role of Project Manager was listed for candidates with 5+ years of experience. On paper, I didn’t qualify. Normally, my CV would’ve been rejected instantly by an HR. But Vikrant, with his founder’s instinct when reviewed my profile, he personally reached out.

Our interview went on for over an hour, we talked about my entrepreneurial journey, mindset, and what pushed me to gain corporate exposure. He hired me as a Junior Digital Project Coordinator, and within three months, recognizing my work, promoted me to Project Manager. I eventually led tech, design and business consulting projects, blending creativity with strategy, something I truly enjoyed.

I left Kurieta because I wanted to work on my own idea while pursuing my Master’s. When I brought it up, Vikrant (the founder) actually offered me the chance to continue working with them while developing my idea. Difficult to find an employer like that, truly.
Eventually, I decided to step away because I knew it would be hard to give 100% to a company that supports me while balancing studies and my own plans. Still, I have huge respect for him and the team.

position.title: Content Creator | E-Learning Industry
position.description:
During my final year in my bachelor’s, I worked on creating learning content and concepts for virtual simulations aimed at students from classes 5 to 10. My role was to think creatively about how to make learning fun, taking textbook concepts and turning them into engaging, interactive experiences.

I had zero background in the e-learning space when I started. The person who hired me simply believed in my creativity, and that’s what got me onboard. At first, I almost refused the offer because I knew I’d have to re-study every topic to ensure accuracy. But once I began, it turned out to be one of the most enjoyable projects that I’ve done. Both creative and meaningful.

This experience gave me a deep respect for professionals in the e-learning industry who genuinely make learning accessible and exciting. I eventually chose to move toward SaaS, but this short stint left a lasting impression and taught me a lot about how creativity and education can come together.

position.title: Sr Business Analyst
position.description: When I started as a Business Analyst at Apparatus Solutions, I wasn’t entirely sure what the role entailed or where it would lead me. However, over time, through hands-on experience and learning, I developed a clear understanding of my strengths and passions within the field. By the time I left, I knew exactly what career path I wanted to pursue next.

position.title: Jr Business Analyst
position.description:
About 70% of my professional skills were developed during my time at Apparatus Solutions, which was my first corporate experience. I dedicated up to 14-hour per day on some occasions to keep pace with IT industry while managing academic assignments and exams, especially in subjects that were less engaging or foundational.

This experience not only honed my technical and analytical skills but also taught me perseverance, time management, and adaptability in a challenging work-study environment

data.summary:
As a passionate computer scientist with a strong foundation in Software Engineering, I am currently pursuing an MSc in Software Systems Engineering at the Hasso Plattner Institute, specializing in AI, machine learning, and computer vision. My research spans projects on disentangled variational autoencoders and few-shot semantic segmentation with 3D point clouds, exploring innovative approaches to complex data and representation learning.

I bring hands-on experience across the banking, financial, and healthcare sectors, delivering scalable, high-quality software solutions. I am proficient in Kotlin, Java, Spring Boot, Angular, React.js, Next.js, .NET, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Oracle, and Docker, and experienced in designing and testing robust applications with tools like MockK for unit testing.

Thriving in collaborative, fast-paced environments, I leverage industry best practices to drive project efficiency and innovation. I am particularly motivated by solving challenging problems, meeting tight deadlines, and delivering solutions that make a tangible impact.

I am eager to contribute my technical expertise, problem-solving skills, and creativity to forward-thinking organizations, building software that pushes boundaries and shapes the future of technology.

My research spans projects on disentangled variational autoencoders and few-shot semantic segmentation with 3D point clouds, exploring innovative approaches to complex data and representation learning.

I bring hands-on experience across the banking, financial, and healthcare sectors, delivering scalable, high-quality software solutions. I am proficient in Kotlin, Java, Spring Boot, Angular, React.js, Next.js, .NET, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Oracle, and Docker, and experienced in designing and testing robust applications with tools like MockK for unit testing.

Thriving in collaborative, fast-paced environments, I leverage industry best practices to drive project efficiency and innovation. I am particularly motivated by solving challenging problems, meeting tight deadlines, and delivering solutions that make a tangible impact.

I am eager to contribute my technical expertise, problem-solving skills, and creativity to forward-thinking organizations, building software that pushes boundaries and shapes the future of technology.

position.title: Intern in Corporate Coverage
position.description:
Intern, Corporate & Institutional Banking (CIB) – Corporate Coverage
 
- Supported the coverage team in advising German large- and mid-cap corporates across the full CIB product suite, including syndicated & acquisition finance, project finance, GTM, CM, ABS, and ECM/DCM

- Prepared pitch books, account plans, and briefing materials for C-level client meetings, covering company profiles, capital structure analyses, and peer benchmarking

- Analyzed clients' financial statements and financing needs to identify refinancing and cross-selling opportunities

- Coordinated post-meeting follow-ups with relevant product teams to advance client mandates

position.title: Intern at Seven.One Production GmbH
position.description:
Intern, Seven.One Production GmbH
 
- Contributed to the strategic launch of Joyn Switzerland by supporting initial content delivery, playing a hands-on role in a cross-border market entry within one of Europe's leading media groups

- Managed and maintained metadata across the internal Media Asset Management (MAM) system for streaming platforms in Germany, Austria, and Switzerland, ensuring content accuracy and operational readiness across a multi-market distribution footprint

- Coordinated the end-to-end delivery of video, text, and image assets to key commercial partners and distribution platforms — including Amazon Prime Video, Joyn, MagentaTV, and Vodafone — supporting revenue-generating content partnerships across the DACH region

position.title: Intern at BMW M GmbH
position.description:
Intern, Integration & Development, BMW M GmbH

- Coordinated international fleet planning and vehicle ordering processes in close cooperation with BMW production plants in Spartanburg (USA) and San Luis Potosí (Mexico), gaining exposure to cross-border supply chain and production-capacity considerations
 
- Supported the planning and preparation of product-testing events for the management board in Miramas (France), coordinating logistics and timelines across international stakeholders
 
- Organized product information, press materials, and comparison drives, contributing to competitive benchmarking and go-to-market communication for new vehicle models

honors.description: As part of the business@school project, a business plan competition organised by the Boston Consulting Group, we invented reAppled. reAppled produces biobased and biodegradable plastic based on apple pomace and initially sells it as a bottle cap. Apple pomace is the solid residue that is a waste product from apple juice production. In this way, we create added value for the environment and offer a substitute for petroleum-based plastics. We made it to the national finals in Munich with this idea.

position.title: Co-Founder
position.description:
We drove Forward from a project at university to a real business with real customers in the B2B & B2C market. We were fortunate enough to get accepted at the RedBrick Pre-Accelerator program, a start-up accelerator based in Tampere, Finland (https://redbrick.fi/).

Forward is a platform that matches students (high school & university) with companies for internships with long-term benefits for both sides.
 
Benefits for students: 
     - exposure to different jobs through short-term internships
     - less uncertainty when choosing a major at university
     - less dropping and switching majors at university
     - discovering career options
     - more clarity for upcoming career path

Benefits for companies: 
     - less effort for HR recruiting processes 
     - more applications for junior job positions
     - help with PR marketing
     - finding better matching employees

data.summary: Senior Planning and Procurement Engineer with more than 25 years of experience in building construction, real estate development, urban infrastructure and large-scale industrial projects.  I work across executive planning, cost management, budgeting, contracts, procurement and physical-financial control, with involvement in projects representing over R$3 billion in investment in the high-end residential, corporate, healthcare, industrial and infrastructure segments.  Hands-on experience in developing and managing executive schedules, WBS, critical path analysis (PERT/CPM), physical-financial planning, S-curves, Earned Value Management (EVM), productivity analysis, Estimate at Completion (EAC) and performance indicators that support strategic decision-making.  Strong track record in cost estimating and contract management, including quantity take-offs, unit cost build-ups, BDI (overhead and profit markup), ABC curve, progress measurements, change orders, price escalation, claims and contract negotiation. Consolidated experience in construction procurement, running competitive tender processes, negotiating with suppliers and aligning purchasing with the critical milestones of each project.  Throughout my career I have delivered projects within the agreed schedules, with average savings of 7% against approved budgets and returns above initial investment projections. Highlights include planning and procurement management of R$1.31 billion in industrial units at COMPERJ/Petrobras, supervision of approximately R$100 million in IDB-funded contracts, and forensic engineering work that generated significant financial recovery for clients.  Experience as an Owner's Engineer, representing the investor's interests and balancing schedule, cost, quality, risk and return on investment.  Areas of expertise: Construction Planning, Cost Management, Budgeting, Contracts, Procurement, Real Estate Development, Cost Engineering, Power BI, KPI Management, Investment Analysis and Stakeholder Management.  Interested in contributing to contractors, developers, project management firms, real estate funds and infrastructure companies in leadership and strategic project management positions.  Open to connections and opportunities to exchange experience on construction planning, project management, real estate development, cost engineering and project development.  Contact: ugf.rafael@gmail.com

position.title: Senior Planning and Supply Engineer | Owner's Engineer

multiLocaleTitle.en_US: Senior Planning and Supply Engineer | Owner's Engineer
multiLocaleTitle.pt_BR: Engenheiro de Planejamento e Suprimentos Sênior | Owner's Engineer

position.description:
Responsibilities

•Planning, budgeting, contracts and procurement for high-end residential developments from the owner's perspective.

•Development of WBS, executive schedules in MS Project, baselines, resource histograms and physical-financial schedules.

•Construction cost and budget management, including quantity take-offs, unit cost build-ups, BDI, ABC curve and feasibility analysis.

•Structuring and administration of lump-sum and unit-price construction contracts, defining measurement criteria, retainage, change orders and price escalation.

•Full procurement cycle: RFQs, comparative bid analysis, commercial negotiation, purchase order issuance, expediting and supplier logistics management.

•Monitoring of performance indicators, productivity, physical-financial progress and Earned Value Management (EVM) to support investor and stakeholder decision-making.

•Development of management dashboards in Power BI and Excel for executive reporting and performance tracking, integrated with AI tools.

Results and Impact
•100% of projects delivered within the schedules and budgets agreed with clients.

•Planning, control and procurement management for the retrofit of Edifício Guilhermina Butler Service (Leblon), a project valued at approximately R$2 million.

•Coordination of planning, control and procurement for the retrofit of a high-end residential penthouse in Ipanema, approximately 400 m² and R$800 thousand in investment.

•Forensic engineering and cost expert work on the structural strengthening of Shopping Tijuca, contributing to approximately R$33 million assessed in favour of the client (BR Malls / Allos).

•Implementation of monitoring routines with executive dashboards for productivity, physical-financial progress, contract performance and Estimate at Completion (EAC).

multiLocaleTitle.en_US: Real Estate Development & Construction Manager | Planning, Budgeting and Procurement
multiLocaleTitle.pt_BR: Gerente de Incorporação e Obras | Planejamento, Orçamentos e Suprimentos

position.description:
Responsibilities

•Management of the full development cycle of high-end residential projects, from technical and economic feasibility and massing studies through to final delivery.

•Strategic planning of developments, with accountability for schedule, budget, quality and investment profitability.

•Preparation of feasibility studies, financial analyses and budgets for investments exceeding R$100 million.

•Development of baseline budgets, physical-financial schedules, ABC curves for materials and executive construction planning.

•Structuring and administration of construction and supply contracts, covering scope, price, schedule, progress measurements, retainage, price escalation and change orders.

•Management of competitive tender processes and negotiation with suppliers, subcontractors and strategic partners.

•Management of critical procurement, aligning purchasing and contracting with the critical path of each development.

•Coordination of multidisciplinary design, change management and interfaces between technical teams, suppliers and investors.
•Monitoring of KPIs, S-curves, physical-financial progress and performance indicators reported to the board and to investors.

Results

•Delivery of five developments within the established schedules, ensuring operational and financial predictability.

•Average returns 12% above the projected Internal Rate of Return (IRR) for the investments.

•Structuring of contracting and procurement processes that improved cost control, reduced contractual risk and enhanced project financial performance.

•Integrated management of stakeholders, investors, designers, contractors and suppliers throughout the entire development cycle.

Developments (Rio de Janeiro)

•Edifício Urquiza – Leblon
•Residencial Caravelle – Botafogo
•Residencial Lygia Reisen – Jardim Botânico
•High-end private residences – Petrópolis and Jardim Botânico
