position.title: Planning & Cost Engineer
position.description:
Responsibilities

•Preparation of budgets, cost spreadsheets, calculation memoranda and physical-financial schedules for projects across different segments.

•Development of economic feasibility studies and cost engineering analyses.

•Forensic engineering and valuation work for insurance loss adjustment and technical assistance in litigation and arbitration.

•Technical site inspections, damage quantification, scope analysis and reconstruction cost estimates.

•Analysis of contracts, claims, progress measurements and discrepancies between contracted scope and executed works.

•Interface with insurers, brokers, law firms and client engineering teams.

•Participation in technical analyses involving the roof of Nilton Santos Stadium (Engenhão), the Copersucar warehouse fire and losses in large-scale buildings.

•Strengthened client decision-making through highly complex technical, financial and contractual analyses.

position.description:

•Integration of engineering, supply and erection schedules, increasing execution predictability.

•Monitoring of critical disciplines including civil works, structural steel, industrial piping, electromechanical erection, testing and commissioning.

•Contribution to operational alignment across multiple technical areas, reducing delay risk and interface conflicts.

•Support to the management of major industrial contracts through continuous monitoring of productivity, performance and strategic milestones.

Projects

•Naphtha HDT Unit
•COMPERJ Infrastructure

multiLocaleSummary.en: Senior Planning and Procurement Engineer with more than 25 years of experience in building construction, real estate development, urban infrastructure and large-scale industrial projects.  I work across executive planning, cost management, budgeting, contracts, procurement and physical-financial control, with involvement in projects representing over R$3 billion in investment in the high-end residential, corporate, healthcare, industrial and infrastructure segments.  Hands-on experience in developing and managing executive schedules, WBS, critical path analysis (PERT/CPM), physical-financial planning, S-curves, Earned Value Management (EVM), productivity analysis, Estimate at Completion (EAC) and performance indicators that support strategic decision-making.  Strong track record in cost estimating and contract management, including quantity take-offs, unit cost build-ups, BDI (overhead and profit markup), ABC curve, progress measurements, change orders, price escalation, claims and contract negotiation. Consolidated experience in construction procurement, running competitive tender processes, negotiating with suppliers and aligning purchasing with the critical milestones of each project.  Throughout my career I have delivered projects within the agreed schedules, with average savings of 7% against approved budgets and returns above initial investment projections. Highlights include planning and procurement management of R$1.31 billion in industrial units at COMPERJ/Petrobras, supervision of approximately R$100 million in IDB-funded contracts, and forensic engineering work that generated significant financial recovery for clients.  Experience as an Owner's Engineer, representing the investor's interests and balancing schedule, cost, quality, risk and return on investment.  Areas of expertise: Construction Planning, Cost Management, Budgeting, Contracts, Procurement, Real Estate Development, Cost Engineering, Power BI, KPI Management, Investment Analysis and Stakeholder Management.  Interested in contributing to contractors, developers, project management firms, real estate funds and infrastructure companies in leadership and strategic project management positions.  Open to connections and opportunities to exchange experience on construction planning, project management, real estate development, cost engineering and project development.  Contact: ugf.rafael@gmail.com
multiLocaleSummary.pt: Engenheiro de Planejamento e Suprimentos Sênior, com mais de 25 anos de experiência em construção civil, incorporação imobiliária, infraestrutura urbana e projetos industriais de grande porte.Atuação em planejamento executivo, gestão de custos, orçamento, contratos, suprimentos e controle físico-financeiro de empreendimentos, com participação em projetos que somam mais de R$ 3 bilhões em investimentos nos segmentos residencial de alto padrão, corporativo, hospitalar, industrial e infraestrutura.Experiência na elaboração e gestão de cronogramas executivos, EAP/WBS, caminho crítico (PERT/CPM), planejamento físico-financeiro, Curva S, Valor Agregado (EVM), análise de produtividade, projeções de término (EAC) e indicadores de desempenho voltados à tomada de decisão estratégica.Sólida atuação em orçamentação e gestão contratual, incluindo quantitativos, composição de custos unitários, BDI, Curva ABC, medições, aditivos, reajustes, pleitos e negociação contratual. Vivência consolidada em compras e suprimentos de obras, conduzindo processos de concorrência, negociação com fornecedores e gestão de aquisições alinhadas aos marcos críticos dos empreendimentos.Ao longo da carreira, conduzi empreendimentos entregues dentro dos prazos estabelecidos, com economia média de 7% sobre os orçamentos previstos e retornos superiores às projeções iniciais de investimento. Entre os resultados de destaque, estão a gestão de planejamento e suprimentos de R$ 1,31 bilhão em unidades industriais do COMPERJ/Petrobras, a fiscalização de aproximadamente R$ 100 milhões em contratos financiados pelo BID e a atuação em perícias de engenharia que resultaram em ganhos financeiros expressivos para contratantes.Experiência como Owner's Engineer, atuando na defesa dos interesses do investidor e garantindo equilíbrio entre prazo, custo, qualidade, riscos e retorno do investimento.Competências em Planejamento de Obras, Gestão de Custos, Orçamentos, Contratos, Suprimentos, Incorporação Imobiliária, Engenharia de Custos, Power BI, Gestão de Indicadores, Análise de Investimentos e Gestão de Stakeholders.Interesse em contribuir com construtoras, incorporadoras, gerenciadoras de projetos, fundos imobiliários e empresas de infraestrutura em posições de liderança e gestão estratégica de empreendimentos.Aberto a conexões e oportunidades para troca de experiências sobre planejamento, gestão de obras, incorporação imobiliária, engenharia de custos e desenvolvimento de projetos.📩 Contato: ugf.rafael@gmail.com
